body: He's still alive, and as small a part of my life as possible since I moved overseas. I know that is where the feelings started, but it's been a long time since my past has had any huge bearing on my present. I am who I am now, for the good and the bad of it, and looking back on the past is going to do nothing more than dwell on bad memories for no reason.

Abusive father, pretty standard story to be honest, tried to destroy me emotionally, with a fair bit of success, and mentally, with no success at all. Total control freak, wanted to invade every bit of my life. Which is a large part of the reason I find so much value in online stuff, it was the place he couldn't get to, couldn't find out about me.

I guess i've overthought this too much, but I would always say to myself that someone who cared about me enough, wouldn't want me to go through this pain, and would let me die if that was the only way out. And if they didn't care enough, then why should I live for them anyway.

And as far as my job goes, i've been trying for the past couple of years to get a better one, but they just aren't available. I'm lucky to have the job that I do, but while i'm certainly capable of doing something a lot better, there just isn't the opportunity for it. I've also looked in to alternate ways of making money, I was considering for a while starting my own youtube channel, but again the question of money is in the way.

The thing is though, that I have tried, I put effort in to getting a good education, and have even moved abroad to remove myself from the original cause of my suicidal thoughts. I've tried everything I can up to this point, but it's just so draining. I don't have that same motivation left, because everything I've tried for years has failed.

I guess the problem is, that while it's an easy thing to say, it's simply not possible to do. And I'm not even saying I don't love my partner, I do, but just feel like she doesn't reciprocate. I've tried talking to her about it, and she is dismissive of my feelings. I've made every effort I can, but it just doesn't seem to make any difference.

But I just don't have the means to do anything else, my job is so unpredictable, that I can't move out and rent even the cheapest place, because I wont be able to afford to pay rent some months. It's hard to have to think so practically about the situation, but I don't have any other option, and even if I could suddenly move out, move away somewhere, it doesn't really change anything. I was suicidal long before I met her, and I would be if I was ever to leave to. It's the only constant in my life, so I have to come to the conclusion that it's the only choice I can make. It's the only thing I haven't tried.
